name: Codrops Creative Hub
tagline: 1,000+ curated demos across the creative web
description: Codrops has published tutorials and open-source demos since 2009, and the Creative Hub is where all of it now lives in one browsable archive: 3D and WebGL experiments, GSAP-driven interactions, scroll effects, particle systems, layout ideas. Less a library to install and more a reference for what a technique should feel like before you build it yourself.
